run_text_to_image: run the text_to_image action to generate an image from a text prompt using stable diffusion
create_diffusion_request: create a DiffusionRequest with a prompt, inference steps, height, width, and optional seed for image generation
get_pipeline: get a stable diffusion pipeline instance with UNet and VAE models loaded on the available device
get_unet: get a UNet2DConditionModel loaded from pretrained checkpoints with automatic device selection for CPU, MPS, or CUDA
get_vae: get an AutoencoderKL VAE model from stabilityai/sd-vae-ft-ema loaded on the best available device
